variety_description: Medium maturity, medium tall, medium slender grain, high yielding, widely adaptable variety grown in India under irrigated lowland conditions. Developed by ANGRAU (Maruteru) and released in 1997 for cultivation in Southern India. Tolerant to major diseases and pests. Excellent grain and eating quality. Low glycemic index
